suggestions.title: Remove access for ada
suggestions.why: This removes you: once it has run you cannot open the state, and another member has to finish it. Use this when ada no longer needs the state. It stops new records being locked to their key. They keep what they have already read, and an old copy of the bucket still opens with their key, so replace any real secrets they could read where those secrets live.

steps.text: You can no longer open the state once this has run. A member who is left runs the rest, which seals every existing record again under the new key:

suggestions.title: Set a recovery key
suggestions.why: A recovery key is split into shares, any K of which rebuild it, so that the state can still be opened when every member has lost their key. Give each share to a different person, offline. Whoever holds K shares can open the state, so K is a decision about whom to trust together.

Do not commit recovery-shares/. Give each file to a different person, offline.

suggestions.why: The check hashes every record against its name and prints who can read the state.
